purpose: Pins the agent scheduler wire shapes that AgentDomainJson still derives with circe-generic. Derivation places Scala case names on the wire, so renaming a case is a protocol change that no other gate observes: sbt test, mimaReportBinaryIssues, and scalafmtCheckAll all pass through such a rename unchanged.
invariants: every case of every covered sum type appears exactly once
non-ASCII and control bytes survive base64 without reinterpretation
regeneration is a deliberate, reviewed protocol change, never a way to make a failing build pass
supersededBy: P6f.12, which replaces derivation with explicitly owned codecs and stable discriminators
